subject: general
question: Identify the oldest iron and steel company of India from the following options.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata Iron & Steel Company (TISCO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Tata Iron & Steel Company (TISCO)**

 
 
• The Tata Iron and Steel company (TISCO) was established by Dorabji Tata in 1907.
 
• He was committed to fulfill the the dream of his father, Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata, an Indian Pioneer industrialist who founded the Tata Group.
 
• Dorabji Tata was knighted by Edward VII, becoming Sir Dorabji Tata in January 1910.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Visvesvaraya Iron & Steel Works**

 
 
• Visvesvaraya Iron and Steel Works__ is a plant that is __located in Bhadravathi, Karnataka,__ and is involved in the production of pig iron and steel.
 
• It was founded on 18 January 1923 as the "Mysore Iron Works" by Sir M Visvesvaraya who was the 19th Diwan of Mysore and a civil engineer.
 
• Since 1989, it works under the jurisdiction of the Steel Authority of India Limited.
 
• Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is the largest steel-making company in India and one of the seven Maharatna’s of the country’s Central Public Sector Enterprises. It was incorporated in the year 1973.
 
 
 
• Indian Iron and Steel Company (IISCO)
 
 
• IISCO is an integrated steel plant located at Burnpur (now).
 
• It is a steel plant that is a part of the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).
 
• It was established in 1918 as an Indian Iron and Steel Company under the flagship of the Martin Burn group.
 
• It was amalgamated with SAIL in 2006 and renamed IISCO Steel Plant.
 
• It has a crude steel production capacity of 2.5 million tonnes per year.
 
• SAIL is India's 3rd and the world's 20th largest steel-producing company with an annual production of 16.30 million metric tons respectively.
